chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Jarrah al-Mada'ini, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Do not build over graves, and do not decorate the ceilings of houses with images, for indeed the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله disliked that.

key_terms.تُصَوِّرُوا: you make images or decorate with figures
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about building over graves and making images on house ceilings?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a discouragement regarding building over graves and making images on the ceilings of houses. It grounds this ruling in the dislike of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, indicating an aspect of sunnah-based etiquette and legal discouragement.
